BT_CLEAR.name: Bluetooth Clear and Pair
BT_CLEAR.tooltip: Clear bluetooth device and start pairing mode for the selected bluetooth slot.

LALT + A.name: Set focus to Suggested actions
LALT + A.tooltip: Set focus to the first icon in the Suggested actions menu.

LALT + CLICK.name: Insert Cursor
LALT + CLICK.tooltip: Insert cursor (may not work on some Linux distributions).

LALT + ENTER.name: Display properties
LALT + ENTER.tooltip: Display properties for the selected item.

LALT + F4.name: Close active item
LALT + F4.tooltip: Close the active item, or exit the active app.

LALT + F8.name: Show password
LALT + F8.tooltip: Show your password on the sign-in screen.

LALT + LGUI + H.name: Hide Other Apps
LALT + LGUI + H.tooltip: Hide all apps other than the front app.

LALT + LGUI + M.name: Minimize All Windows of App
LALT + LGUI + M.tooltip: Minimize all windows of the front app.

LALT + SPACE.name: Open context menu
LALT + SPACE.tooltip: Open the context menu for the active window.

LCTRL + A.name: Select all
LCTRL + A.tooltip: Select all items in a document or window.

LCTRL + B.name: Apply bold format
LCTRL + B.tooltip: Apply the bold format to the selected text.

LCTRL + BACKSPACE.name: Delete words to the left
LCTRL + BACKSPACE.tooltip: Delete words to the left of the cursor.

LCTRL + DELETE.name: Delete words to the right
LCTRL + DELETE.tooltip: Delete words to the right of the cursor.

LCTRL + DOWN.name: App Exposé
LCTRL + DOWN.tooltip: Show all windows of the front app.

LCTRL + END.name: Move to end of document
LCTRL + END.tooltip: Move the cursor forward to the end of the document.

LCTRL + F4.name: Close active document
LCTRL + F4.tooltip: Close the active document (in apps that are full-screen and let you have multiple documents open at the same time).

LCTRL + HOME.name: Move to beginning of document
LCTRL + HOME.tooltip: Move the cursor backward to the beginning of the document.

LCTRL + I.name: Apply italic format
LCTRL + I.tooltip: Apply the italic format to the selected text.

LCTRL + LSHIFT + TAB.name: Prev Tab
LCTRL + LSHIFT + TAB.tooltip: Switches focus to the previous tab in order.

LCTRL + TAB.name: Next Tab
LCTRL + TAB.tooltip: Switches focus to the next tab in order.

LCTRL + U.name: Apply underline format
LCTRL + U.tooltip: Apply the underline format to the selected text.

LCTRL + V.name: Paste from clipboard
LCTRL + V.tooltip: Paste the last item from the clipboard.

LED_COLOR_BLUE.name: LED Blue
LED_COLOR_BLUE.tooltip: Set base color of backlight to Blue (color may be overwritten by effect).

LED_COLOR_CYAN.name: LED Cyan
LED_COLOR_CYAN.tooltip: Set base color of backlight to Cyan (color may be overwritten by effect).

LED_COLOR_GREEN.name: LED Green
LED_COLOR_GREEN.tooltip: Set base color of backlight to Green (color may be overwritten by effect).

LED_COLOR_MAGENTA.name: LED Magenta
LED_COLOR_MAGENTA.tooltip: Set base color of backlight to Magenta (color may be overwritten by effect).

LED_COLOR_ORANGE.name: LED Orange
LED_COLOR_ORANGE.tooltip: Set base color of backlight to Orange (color may be overwritten by effect).

LED_COLOR_PINK.name: LED Pink
LED_COLOR_PINK.tooltip: Set base color of backlight to Pink (color may be overwritten by effect).

LED_COLOR_RED.name: LED Red
LED_COLOR_RED.tooltip: Set base color of backlight to Red (color may be overwritten by effect).

LED_COLOR_WHITE.name: LED White
LED_COLOR_WHITE.tooltip: Set base color of backlight to White (color may be overwritten by effect).

LED_COLOR_YELLOW.name: LED Yellow
LED_COLOR_YELLOW.tooltip: Set base color of backlight to Yellow (color may be overwritten by effect).

LGUI + C.name: Copy
LGUI + C.tooltip: Copy the selected item to the Clipboard.

LGUI + D.name: Add Selection to Next Find match
LGUI + D.tooltip: Add selection to next Find match.

LGUI + F.name: Find
LGUI + F.tooltip: Find items in a document or open a Find window.

LGUI + F2.name: Select All Word Occurrences
LGUI + F2.tooltip: Select all occurrences of current word.

LGUI + G.name: Find Next
LGUI + G.tooltip: Find the next occurrence of the item previously found.

LGUI + H.name: Hide
LGUI + H.tooltip: Hide the windows of the front app.

LGUI + LCTRL + F4.name: Close virtual desktop
LGUI + LCTRL + F4.tooltip: Close the virtual desktop you are using.

LGUI + LCTRL + LEFT.name: Switch to left virtual desktop
LGUI + LCTRL + LEFT.tooltip: Switch between virtual desktops you've created on the left.

LGUI + LCTRL + RIGHT.name: Switch to right virtual desktop
LGUI + LCTRL + RIGHT.tooltip: Switch between virtual desktops you've created on the right.

LGUI + LSHIFT + L.name: Select All Occurrences
LGUI + LSHIFT + L.tooltip: Select all occurrences of current selection.

LGUI + O.name: Open
LGUI + O.tooltip: Open the selected item, or open a dialog to select a file to open.

LGUI + V.name: Paste
LGUI + V.tooltip: Paste the contents of the Clipboard into the current document or app.

LGUI + X.name: Cut
LGUI + X.tooltip: Cut the selected item and copy it to the Clipboard.

LGUI + Z.name: Undo
LGUI + Z.tooltip: Undo the previous command. In some apps, you can undo and redo multiple commands.

LSHIFT + DOWN.name: Select lines forward
LSHIFT + DOWN.tooltip: Select lines forward from the current cursor position.

LSHIFT + END.name: Select to end of line
LSHIFT + END.tooltip: Select text from the current cursor position to the end of the current line.

LSHIFT + F8.name: Go to Previous Error
LSHIFT + F8.tooltip: Go to previous error or warning.

LSHIFT + HOME.name: Select to beginning of line
LSHIFT + HOME.tooltip: Select text from the current cursor position to the beginning of the current line.

LSHIFT + LALT + I.name: Insert Cursor at End of Line
LSHIFT + LALT + I.tooltip: Insert cursor at end of each line selected.

LSHIFT + LCTRL + DOWN.name: Select paragraphs forward
LSHIFT + LCTRL + DOWN.tooltip: Select paragraphs forward from the current cursor position.

LSHIFT + LCTRL + END.name: Select to end of document
LSHIFT + LCTRL + END.tooltip: Select text between the current cursor position and the end of the document.

LSHIFT + LCTRL + HOME.name: Select to beginning of document
LSHIFT + LCTRL + HOME.tooltip: Select text between the current cursor position and the beginning of the document.

LSHIFT + LCTRL + LEFT.name: Select words backward
LSHIFT + LCTRL + LEFT.tooltip: Select words backward from the current cursor position.

LSHIFT + LCTRL + RIGHT.name: Select words forward
LSHIFT + LCTRL + RIGHT.tooltip: Select words forward from the current cursor position.

LSHIFT + LCTRL + UP.name: Select paragraphs backward
LSHIFT + LCTRL + UP.tooltip: Select paragraphs backward from the current cursor position.

LSHIFT + LEFT.name: Select characters backward
LSHIFT + LEFT.tooltip: Select characters backward from the current cursor position.

LSHIFT + LGUI + G.name: Find Previous
LSHIFT + LGUI + G.tooltip: Find the previous occurrence of the item previously found.

LSHIFT + LGUI + Z.name: Redo
LSHIFT + LGUI + Z.tooltip: Redo, reversing the undo command. In some apps, you can undo and redo multiple commands.

LSHIFT + PG_DN.name: Select one page forward
LSHIFT + PG_DN.tooltip: Select one page of text forward from the current cursor position.

LSHIFT + PG_UP.name: Select one page backward
LSHIFT + PG_UP.tooltip: Select one page of text backward from the current cursor position.

LSHIFT + RIGHT.name: Select characters forward
LSHIFT + RIGHT.tooltip: Select characters forward from the current cursor position.

LSHIFT + UP.name: Select lines backward
LSHIFT + UP.tooltip: Select lines backward from the current cursor position.

TRANSPARENT.name: Transparent
TRANSPARENT.tooltip: Key copies binding from next (lower) active layer.

USB_DEVICE.name: Connect via USB Cable
USB_DEVICE.tooltip: Output to device connected via usb cable.
